summary: Verified admin panel discoverability fix end-to-end. Backend /api/auth/login returns 200+JWT for valid creds (jalucas@hotmail.it/GlitzAdmin2026!) and 401 for wrong password; /api/auth/me returns admin email with Bearer token. Desktop nav (1920) shows both ACCEDI (data-testid=header-login-btn) and AREA ADMIN (data-testid=header-admin-link) inside <nav>, separated by vertical divider. Clicking AREA ADMIN navigates to /admin/login; submitting valid creds routes to /admin and all 7 admin tabs render (tab-events, tab-posts, tab-faqs, tab-media, tab-bookings, tab-private, tab-settings). Mobile (390) hamburger menu opens a separated section with both mobile-login and mobile-admin-link; clicking mobile-admin-link navigates to /admin/login. Regression: only one ACCEDI element in header and it lives inside <nav> (no stray floating pill next to WhatsApp button).
critical_code_review_comments: Footer still contains a duplicate 'Area Riservata' link (data-testid=footer-admin-link) to /admin/login — now redundant with the visible header 'AREA ADMIN'. Consider removing for a single source of truth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login flow via email/password works. Google OAuth branch (user.is_admin -> header-admin-dash / mobile-admin-dash) not testable via automation (external OAuth). All required data-testid attributes present in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx.
rca of the issue: Original UX bug: admin entry point was only a tiny 'Area Riservata' link at footer bottom. Fix in Layout.jsx adds visible ACCEDI + AREA ADMIN inside desktop <nav> after a divider, and a divided section in the mobile hamburger with mobile-login + mobile-admin-link. Both entries verified visible and functional.
